brief:
Israeli occupation authorities forced Jerusalem resident Hani al-Slaymeh to evacuate his home and his father's home in the Wadi Qaddum neighborhood of Silwan, south of Al-Aqsa Mosque, in preparation for their forced demolition, Shehab Wire reported. The authorities cited unlicensed construction as justification for the demolitions.

Al-Slaymeh and his family currently reside in the first home, which is now subject to the evacuation order.
